mandatoryCriteria: Owner and manager board creation: Workspace owner and project manager can create boards via POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/boards; members and viewers receive 403 FORBIDDEN (404 for ungranted project)

Atomic default columns: Creating a board atomically inserts exactly 4 default columns in order: "Not started" (todo, pos 0), "In progress" (active, pos 1), "Testing" (active, pos 2), "Completed" (done, pos 3)
Ancestry and versioning: Board inherits workspace_id and project_id from project; initializes structure_version=1 and snapshot_version=1
Idempotency enforcement: POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/boards requires valid Idempotency-Key header and returns idempotent receipt
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Board creation and atomic default column creation with idempotency on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Archiving board (BRD-08).
